point_provenance: Manual visual estimates on raw fixed crops: crop x0,y400, scale0.5. Original coordinates below; boots/occlusion not clearly distinguishable are uncertain. Same agent has seen earlier candidates; no independent or blinded accuracy claim. Do not alter these labels to improve evaluation scores.

events.note: Red player under pressure releases to central supporting red player, who receives then releases a second pass. Separate transfers; do not merge into one long pass.
Central red player passes backwards/left to deeper red receiver.
Red player near centre-circle edge passes toward red teammate nearer the near touchline.
White player escapes tackle and passes toward right-side white defender; backward/lateral pass, not a goal attempt.

negative_examples.note: Contact/turnover/overlap alone does not establish a completed transfer.
Ball moves toward goal side of image but is a white defensive pass to a white teammate.
Player down near touchline and raised assistant flag; no observed goal attempt in this review window.

uncertain_events.note: Near-touchline transfer/challenge; on-field receipt uncertain after boundary filtering. Not scored as a negative or completed pass.

shot_labels_note: No positive shot labelled in the closed review windows. This cannot measure shot recall or prove the clip has zero shots globally. Current pipeline has no implemented shot predictor.
